title: Food on the Table
subtitle: The Mary Celeste · Atlantic Ocean, 1872
voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.
grade: Desaturated documentary still, a 19th-century brigantine sailing ship adrift in the open Atlantic Ocean in December 1872, grey heavy overcast sky, glassy swells, weathered teak and salt-stained wood, brass fittings, canvas sails furled and damp, melancholy and uncanny, period 1872 maritime detail, cinematic wide composition, fine film grain, no text, no signage, no people, no faces.

beats.vo: In December 1872, a ship was found adrift in the Atlantic, between the Azores and Portugal.
beats.img: A 19th-century wooden brigantine sailing ship becalmed on a glassy grey Atlantic swell under heavy overcast, distant horizon, viewed from another ship's deck, eerie and remote, no people.

beats.vo: The Mary Celeste was in good order. Her cargo was untouched. There was food on the table.
beats.img: The interior of a 19th-century ship's captain's cabin, a wooden table set with pewter plates and a half-eaten meal, brass lantern dimly lit, weathered teak, porthole grey daylight, melancholy and eerie, no people.

beats.vo: The captain, his wife, their daughter, and seven crew were all gone. A single lifeboat was missing.
beats.cap:
Ten people gone
one lifeboat missing
beats.img: Empty wooden davits on the side of a 19th-century sailing ship where a lifeboat once hung, grey Atlantic sea beyond, damp furled sails, weathered rope, melancholy, no people.

beats.vo: No sign of storm. No sign of violence. No sign of anyone.
beats.img: Empty wooden deck of a 19th-century brigantine with damp furled sails and salt-stained railing seen at an angle, low grey overcast, distant empty horizon, desolate, no people.

beats.vo: What happened on that ship has never been determined.
beats.img: A distant view of a 19th-century brigantine under bare grey overcast sky on a calm empty Atlantic, the small silhouette of a ship alone on the water, fading into mist, melancholy and unresolved, no people.
